newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia restarts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia restarts.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said on Monday it had reinitiated coverage of Argentina's Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires SA with a rating of strong buy.

-- Analysts Helen Cho and Cynthia Harlow said in a report that "earnings momentum, a very strong balance sheet, consolidating market share and leading retail position make Galicia our top Argentine bank pick."
-- New earnings estimates for fiscal year 1997 and 1998 are $1.64 and $2.02 a share, respectively. The 12-month price target is $26.50 a share.
-- The company's shares opened up 3/8 to 19-1/4.
